notes.opencode: OpenCode Go is subscription-priced ($12 per 5h usage budget on https://opencode.ai/docs/go). Each model entry uses one subscription-equivalent USD/M rate for input, cached input, and output: ($12 ÷ requests-per-5h) ÷ ((typical input + cached + output tokens per request) ÷ 1e6), using the request limits and typical token mix published on that page. Keys use opencode-go/<model-id>. Cost attribution charges the stored non-cached input bucket and cached input bucket separately; public total-input reporting adds them.
notes.claude: Cache-hit (read) rate captured under cachedInputPerMillion. Cache-write rates (1.25x base for 5m, 2x for 1h) are not represented; cost framework treats CachedInputTokens as read-side discount.
notes.codex: gpt-5.5 short-context rate ($5/$30). codex-5.5 aliases the same rate for CLI JSON attribution. Long-context tier (above ~270k input tokens) is not represented.
notes.caveman: Caveman-code is BYOK: the operator pays the backing provider directly, so rates mirror the codex bucket (OpenAI ids) and the claude bucket (Anthropic ids) for the same model ids. Keys ship in both bare (gpt-5.5) and provider-prefixed (openai/gpt-5.5) forms because the CLI reports either depending on how --model was given. Only registry-verified ids are seeded; add further provider ids under CodeyBox:AgentPricing as operators adopt them.
notes.gemini: gemini-3-flash-preview is the default AgentClasses model. Pro preview models use short-context rates (<= 200k tokens); long-context tier (>200k) is not represented.
notes.cursor: Cursor uses a flat subscription and does not publish per-token rates; intentionally omitted from defaults.
notes.copilot: Copilot uses a flat subscription and does not publish per-token rates; intentionally omitted from defaults.
notes.crock: CrockCode is a pay-per-token Anthropic API-key path that rides the Message Batches API (~50% discount applied by Anthropic at billing time). Rates below are the post-batch-discount effective rates (half of the on-demand /v1/messages rate for the same model id). Keys mirror the canonical Anthropic model ids. Cost attribution is an ESTIMATE, not exact spend: like the claude bucket, cache-write (cache_creation) tokens are folded into fresh input at the base rate and Anthropic's 1.25x/2x cache-write premium is not represented. DefaultRates.crock is the Opus-tier upper-bound fallback for any model id not enumerated here.
notes.pi: Pi is a multi-provider front; rates depend on the backing provider. The shipped AgentClasses member routes Anthropic, so this bucket mirrors the Anthropic on-demand rates for the models operators route through pi. Keys are the bare provider model ids pi reports in message.model (pi strips the provider/ qualifier), so operator overrides use the same bare form. Operators fronting other providers add that provider's list prices here (or under CodeyBox:AgentPricing) keyed by the bare message.model id.
notes.aider: Aider is a multi-provider front routed through litellm; rates depend on the backing provider. The shipped AgentClasses member routes OpenRouter, so this bucket mirrors the OpenRouter list price for that model. Keys are the full aider dispatch ids aider reports in its `Model:` run header (provider/ qualifier retained, e.g. openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5), so operator overrides use the same qualified form. Cost attribution is an ESTIMATE, not exact spend: aider counts cache-write tokens inside its sent total and OpenRouter may add its own margin over provider list prices.
notes.goose: Goose is a multi-provider front; rates depend on the backing provider. The shipped AgentClasses member routes an OpenRouter free-tier model, which bills $0 — the bucket records that zero rate explicitly (verified live: the CLI's own complete frame reports cost_usd 0.0). Keys are the provider-native ids goose reports in message.metadata.inference.requestedModel. Operators fronting paid OpenRouter models add that model's OpenRouter list prices here (or under CodeyBox:AgentPricing) keyed by the same id form.
notes.prime: Prime is a multi-provider front; rates depend on the backing provider. The shipped AgentClasses member routes OpenRouter, so this bucket mirrors the OpenRouter list price for that model. Keys are the provider-catalog ids prime-agent reports verbatim in message.model (e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5), so operator overrides use the same form. Cost attribution is an ESTIMATE, not exact spend: OpenRouter may add its own margin over provider list prices. The nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free row is the $0 free tier (rate-limited) used for smoke verification.
notes.autohand: Autohand is a multi-provider front; rates depend on the backing provider. The shipped AgentClasses member routes an OpenRouter free-tier model, which bills $0 — the bucket records that zero rate explicitly for the dispatched --model id. The bare headless stream carries no machine-readable usage frame, so cost attribution records no row (unknown) until a build emits usage events; the bucket exists so a future usage-bearing build prices the shipped model correctly. Operators fronting paid OpenRouter models add that model's OpenRouter list prices here (or under CodeyBox:AgentPricing) keyed by the same --model id form.
notes.vibe: Vibe is a multi-provider front; rates depend on the backing provider. The shipped AgentClasses member routes an OpenRouter free-tier model (guest alias nemotron-free), which bills $0 — the bucket records that zero rate explicitly keyed by the provider id behind the alias (nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free). Vibe programmatic history entries carry no token counts, so the cost extractor reports unknown and per-run rows fall back to elapsed-time attribution; operators fronting paid OpenRouter models add that model's OpenRouter list prices here (or under CodeyBox:AgentPricing) keyed by the provider id behind their guest alias.
notes.cline: Cline is a multi-provider front; rates depend on the backing provider. The shipped AgentClasses member routes an OpenRouter free-tier model, which bills $0 — the bucket records that zero rate explicitly for the dispatched -m id (verified live: the run_result frame reports totalCost 0 and the model id in model.id). Keys are the provider-native ids cline reports verbatim in run_result.model.id. Operators fronting paid OpenRouter models add that model's OpenRouter list prices here (or under CodeyBox:AgentPricing) keyed by the same id form.
notes.kilo: Kilo is a multi-provider front; rates depend on the backing provider. The shipped AgentClasses member routes an OpenRouter free-tier model, which bills $0 — the bucket records that zero rate explicitly for the dispatched -m id (verified live: the step-finish frame reports cost 0). Keys are the full -m dispatch ids (provider/ qualifier retained, e.g. openai-compatible/nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free) because the stream carries no model id and attribution falls through to the AgentDefaults-derived rate. Operators fronting paid OpenRouter models add that model's OpenRouter list prices here (or under CodeyBox:AgentPricing) keyed by the same -m id form.
notes.omp: OMP is a multi-provider front (oh-my-pi fork of pi); rates depend on the backing provider. The shipped AgentClasses member routes an OpenRouter free-tier model, which bills $0 — the bucket records that zero rate explicitly keyed by the bare message.model id omp reports (verified live: the usage frame reports cost.total 0 and message.model strips the openrouter/ qualifier). Operators fronting paid models add that model's list prices here (or under CodeyBox:AgentPricing) keyed by the bare message.model id.
notes.continue: Continue is a multi-provider front; rates depend on the backing provider. The shipped AgentClasses member routes an OpenRouter free-tier model, which bills $0 — the bucket records that zero rate explicitly for the seeded guest-config model id. The headless transport carries no machine-readable usage frame (only usage lives in the guest session files the extractor cannot reach), so the cost extractor reports unknown and per-run rows fall back to elapsed-time attribution; the bucket exists so a future usage-bearing build prices the shipped model correctly. Operators fronting paid OpenRouter models add that model's OpenRouter list prices here (or under CodeyBox:AgentPricing) keyed by the same model id form.
notes.qwen: Qwen is a multi-provider front (native Qwen, OpenAI-, Anthropic-, and Gemini-compatible endpoints); rates depend on the backing provider. The shipped AgentClasses member routes an OpenRouter free-tier model, which bills $0 — the bucket records that zero rate explicitly for the dispatched -m id (verified live: the result frame reports usage with the dispatch id verbatim in message.model, plus a per-model breakdown in stats.models). Keys are the provider-native ids qwen reports verbatim in message.model. Operators fronting paid models add that model's list prices here (or under CodeyBox:AgentPricing) keyed by the same id form.
